mapper.select: SELECT CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) AS orderId, om.start_at AS startAt, om.end_at AS endAt, om.day_num AS dayNum, om.total_price_cent AS totalPriceCent, COALESCE(do.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0) AS commissionPriceCent, CASE WHEN om.settlement_amount_cent > 0 THEN om.settlement_amount_cent WHEN om.total_pay_price_cent > 0 THEN GREATEST( om.total_pay_price_cent - COALESCE(do.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0), 0 ) ELSE GREATEST( om.total_price_cent - COALESCE(do.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0), 0 ) END AS businessIncomeCent, om.created_at AS createdAt, CAST(om.created_by AS CHAR) AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(pu.nick_name, ''), '系统自动') AS userName FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN distribution_order do ON do.source_order_id = om.order_id AND do.camp_id = om.camp_id AND (do.channel_id = om.channel_id OR do.channel_id IS NULL) LEFT JOIN pms_user pu ON pu.user_id = om.created_by AND pu.is_deleted = 0 WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.order_type = 'daily_room' AND om.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded', 'pending') AND om.start_at < #{rangeEndExclusive} AND om.end_at > #{rangeStart} ORDER BY om.start_at DESC, om.order_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM room r WHERE r.camp_id = #{campId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rc.room_count), 0) FROM room_category rc WHERE rc.camp_id = #{campId} AND rc.is_deleted = 0 AND rc.status = 1
